<title level="1" right="Setting Article" pfs="">[A History of Secrets](/Articles.aspx?ID=98)</title>

**Source** [Pathfinder #206: Bring the House Down](/Sources.aspx?ID=247) pg. 74

[Norgorber](/Deities.aspx?ID=289) is known as a god of poison, greed, and murder, but he's also a god of secrets. Here, for the first time ever, those secrets are laid bare!
